per_candidate.id: s2:Nowcasting Solar EUV Irradiance With Photospheric Magnetic Fields and the Mg II

rationale: Candidates 2607.19225, 2505.04511, 2507.04639, and 2508.20979 provide insights into the mechanisms of coronal heating and magnetic energy dynamics, contributing substantive new evidence on the question of how magnetic energy is injected and released in the solar corona.
